description: Electing reliable partners who believe in the promise of public education is critical to maintaining the excellence we want for our children. We’ve been fortunate to have Laurie Pryor representing our district in St. Paul, a longtime education advocate and chair of the Education Policy Committee, and her retirement leaves some big shoes to fill.In my opinion, Alex Falconer is the right person to continue Laurie’s legacy of fighting for public education. Alex’s children grew up in public schools

title: Letter to the Editor: Support for Falconer as education advocate
